description: Density system controlling component sizing across the UI. All tokens in the Density collection (sizing, spacing, border-width, border-radius) resolve their values based on the active density mode.

figma.library: DB UX DS v3 - Core Foundation
figma.usage: In Figma, densities are activated by setting the Layer Mode on a frame to one of the density modes (expressive, regular, functional). All variables from the Density collection (db-sizing/*, db-spacing/*, db-border-width/*, db-border-radius/*) automatically resolve to the values of the active density mode. This means: change the Layer Mode on a parent frame, and all children using Density collection variables will adapt.

densities.description: Available density modes that affect component sizing and spacing.
densities.figmaActivation: Set via Layer Mode on a frame. All Density collection variables in child layers resolve to the selected mode's values.
densities.codeActivation: Set via data-density attribute on a parent container element.
densities.note: 'functional' is more compact (smaller sizing/spacing values), 'expressive' is more spacious (larger values).

sizing-scale.description: The sizing scale steps available within each density.
